```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(car)
library(lmtest)
library(patchwork)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
cad = read_excel("cadereyta_SE3.xlsx")
jua = read_excel("cadereyta_SE2.xlsx")
guad = read_excel("cadereyta_SE.xlsx")
```


# Cadereyta - Juarez

```{r}
colnames(cad)
```
```{r}
# -------- Limpieza ligera --------
# (No transformamos nombres para respetar tus columnas tal cual)
# Simplemente quitamos 'date' si está presente:
cad <- cad %>% select(-any_of("date"))
jua <- jua %>% select(-any_of("date"))

cad <- cad %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))
jua <- jua %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))

# -------- Métricas sin yardstick --------
rmse_vec <- function(truth, estimate) sqrt(mean((as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) mean(abs(as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate)), na.rm = TRUE)
rsq_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) {
  truth <- as.numeric(truth); estimate <- as.numeric(estimate)
  ss_res <- sum((truth - estimate)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((truth - mean(truth, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  1 - ss_res/ss_tot
}
```

## Caderyta - Juarez (SO2)
```{r}
# Variable objetivo
TARGET <- "SO2"
```

```{r}
# -------- Selección de predictores numéricos --------
stopifnot(TARGET %in% names(cad), TARGET %in% names(jua))

num_cols <- cad %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
drop_cols <- c(TARGET, "nivel_cod", "season")  # quita objetivo y columnas no predictoras
x_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, drop_cols)

# Safety: por si acaso
x_cols <- x_cols[x_cols %in% names(cad)]
stopifnot(length(x_cols) > 0)

# -------- Filtros anti-colinealidad (en TRAIN) --------
# 1) varianza cero
sd_vec <- sapply(cad[x_cols], sd, na.rm = TRUE)
x_cols <- x_cols[sd_vec > 0]

# 3) colinealidad perfecta |r|≈1
if (length(x_cols) > 1) {
  cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(cad[x_cols], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  bad_pairs <- which(abs(cmat) >= 0.99999 & upper.tri(cmat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(bad_pairs) > 0) {
    drop_perfect <- unique(colnames(cmat)[bad_pairs[,2]])
    x_cols <- setdiff(x_cols, drop_perfect)
  }
}
stopifnot(!(TARGET %in% x_cols), length(x_cols) > 0)
```

```{r}
# -------- Estandarización (medias/sd de Cadereyta) --------
scale_stats <- cad %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(x_cols),
                   list(mu = \(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), sd = \(x) sd(x, na.rm=TRUE))))

scale_apply <- function(data, stats_tbl, cols){
  out <- data
  for (v in cols) {
    mu  <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_mu")]]
    sdv <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_sd")]]
    out[[v]] <- if (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0) 0 else (out[[v]] - mu)/sdv
  }
  out
}

cad_s <- scale_apply(cad, scale_stats, x_cols)
jua_s <- scale_apply(jua, scale_stats, x_cols)
```

```{r}
form <- as.formula(paste(TARGET, "~", paste(x_cols, collapse = " + ")))
modelo_SO2 <- lm(form, data = cad_s)
summary(modelo_SO2)
```

```{r}
pred_train <- predict(modelo_SO2, newdata = cad_s)
pred_test  <- predict(modelo_SO2, newdata = jua_s)

metricas <- function(obs, pred){
  tibble(
    RMSE = rmse_vec(obs, pred),
    MAE  = mae_vec(obs, pred),
    R2   = rsq_vec(obs, pred)
  )
}

train_met <- metricas(cad_s[[TARGET]], pred_train) |> mutate(dataset = "Cadereyta (train)")
test_met  <- metricas(jua_s[[TARGET]], pred_test)  |> mutate(dataset = "Juárez (test)")

bind_rows(train_met, test_met)
```

```{r}
vif(modelo_SO2) |> print()
bptest(modelo_SO2) |> print()
dwtest(modelo_SO2) |> print()
```

```{r}
library(nortest)
ad.test(resid(modelo_SO2))            # Anderson–Darling
lillie.test(scale(resid(modelo_SO2))) # Lilliefors (KS ajustado)

library(tseries)
jarque.bera.test(resid(modelo_SO2))   # Jarque–Bera (asimetría/curtosis)
```

```{r}
# QQ plot de residuales
res <- residuals(modelo_SO2)
qqnorm(res); qqline(res)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 7️⃣ GRÁFICAS DE AJUSTE
# =========================
p_train <- tibble(obs = cad_s[[TARGET]], pred = pred_train) |>
  ggplot(aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "Entrenamiento: Cadereyta", x = "Observado", y = "Predicho")

p_test <- tibble(obs = jua_s[[TARGET]], pred = pred_test) |>
  ggplot(aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color="steelblue") +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "Prueba: Juárez", x = "Observado", y = "Predicho")

p_train + p_test
```

## Cadereyta - Juarez (PM10)
```{r}
# Variable objetivo
TARGET <- "PM10"
```

```{r}
# -------- Selección de predictores numéricos --------
stopifnot(TARGET %in% names(cad), TARGET %in% names(jua))

num_cols <- cad %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
drop_cols <- c(TARGET, "nivel_cod", "season")  # quita objetivo y columnas no predictoras
x_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, drop_cols)

# Safety: por si acaso
x_cols <- x_cols[x_cols %in% names(cad)]
stopifnot(length(x_cols) > 0)

# -------- Filtros anti-colinealidad (en TRAIN) --------
# 1) varianza cero
sd_vec <- sapply(cad[x_cols], sd, na.rm = TRUE)
x_cols <- x_cols[sd_vec > 0]

# 2) columnas duplicadas (idénticas)
if (length(x_cols) > 1) {
  mat <- cad[x_cols]
  keep <- c()
  sigs <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  for (nm in x_cols) {
    key <- digest::digest(mat[[nm]]) %||% paste0(round(mat[[nm]], 10), collapse="|")
    if (!exists(key, envir = sigs)) { assign(key, TRUE, envir = sigs); keep <- c(keep, nm) }
  }
  x_cols <- keep
}

# 3) colinealidad perfecta |r|≈1
if (length(x_cols) > 1) {
  cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(cad[x_cols], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  bad_pairs <- which(abs(cmat) >= 0.99999 & upper.tri(cmat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(bad_pairs) > 0) {
    drop_perfect <- unique(colnames(cmat)[bad_pairs[,2]])
    x_cols <- setdiff(x_cols, drop_perfect)
  }
}
stopifnot(!(TARGET %in% x_cols), length(x_cols) > 0)
```

```{r}
form <- as.formula(paste(TARGET, "~", paste(x_cols, collapse = " + ")))
modelo_PM10 <- lm(form, data = cad_s)
summary(modelo_PM10)
```

```{r}
pred_train <- predict(modelo_PM10, newdata = cad_s)
pred_test  <- predict(modelo_PM10, newdata = jua_s)

metricas <- function(obs, pred){
  tibble(
    RMSE = rmse_vec(obs, pred),
    MAE  = mae_vec(obs, pred),
    R2   = rsq_vec(obs, pred)
  )
}

train_met <- metricas(cad_s[[TARGET]], pred_train) |> mutate(dataset = "Cadereyta (train)")
test_met  <- metricas(jua_s[[TARGET]], pred_test)  |> mutate(dataset = "Juárez (test)")

bind_rows(train_met, test_met)
```

## Cadereyta - Juarez (PM2.5)
```{r}
# Variable objetivo
TARGET <- "PM2.5"
```

```{r}
# -------- Selección de predictores numéricos --------
stopifnot(TARGET %in% names(cad), TARGET %in% names(jua))

num_cols <- cad %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
drop_cols <- c(TARGET, "nivel_cod", "season")  # quita objetivo y columnas no predictoras
x_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, drop_cols)

# Safety: por si acaso
x_cols <- x_cols[x_cols %in% names(cad)]
stopifnot(length(x_cols) > 0)

# -------- Imputación por mediana (usando solo Cadereyta) --------
medianas <- cad %>% summarise(across(all_of(c(TARGET, x_cols)), \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
for (v in c(TARGET, x_cols)) {
  med <- pull(medianas, v)
  cad[[v]][is.na(cad[[v]])] <- med
  jua[[v]][is.na(jua[[v]])] <- med
}
cad <- cad %>% drop_na(all_of(c(TARGET, x_cols)))
jua <- jua %>% drop_na(all_of(c(TARGET, x_cols)))

# -------- Filtros anti-colinealidad (en TRAIN) --------
# 1) varianza cero
sd_vec <- sapply(cad[x_cols], sd, na.rm = TRUE)
x_cols <- x_cols[sd_vec > 0]

# 2) columnas duplicadas (idénticas)
if (length(x_cols) > 1) {
  mat <- cad[x_cols]
  keep <- c()
  sigs <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  for (nm in x_cols) {
    key <- digest::digest(mat[[nm]]) %||% paste0(round(mat[[nm]], 10), collapse="|")
    if (!exists(key, envir = sigs)) { assign(key, TRUE, envir = sigs); keep <- c(keep, nm) }
  }
  x_cols <- keep
}

# 3) colinealidad perfecta |r|≈1
if (length(x_cols) > 1) {
  cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(cad[x_cols], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  bad_pairs <- which(abs(cmat) >= 0.99999 & upper.tri(cmat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(bad_pairs) > 0) {
    drop_perfect <- unique(colnames(cmat)[bad_pairs[,2]])
    x_cols <- setdiff(x_cols, drop_perfect)
  }
}
stopifnot(!(TARGET %in% x_cols), length(x_cols) > 0)
```

# Cadereyta - Guadalupe

```{r}
# -------- Limpieza ligera --------
# (No transformamos nombres para respetar tus columnas tal cual)
# Simplemente quitamos 'date' si está presente:
cad <- cad %>% select(-any_of("date"))
guad <- guad %>% select(-any_of("date"))

cad <- cad %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))
guad <- guad %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))

# -------- Métricas sin yardstick --------
rmse_vec <- function(truth, estimate) sqrt(mean((as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) mean(abs(as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate)), na.rm = TRUE)
rsq_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) {
  truth <- as.numeric(truth); estimate <- as.numeric(estimate)
  ss_res <- sum((truth - estimate)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((truth - mean(truth, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  1 - ss_res/ss_tot
}
```

## Cadereyta - Guadalupe (SO2)
```{r}
# Variable objetivo
TARGET <- "SO2"
```

```{r}
# -------- Selección de predictores numéricos --------
stopifnot(TARGET %in% names(cad), TARGET %in% names(guad))

num_cols <- cad %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
drop_cols <- c(TARGET, "nivel_cod", "season")  # quita objetivo y columnas no predictoras
x_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, drop_cols)

# Safety: por si acaso
x_cols <- x_cols[x_cols %in% names(cad)]
stopifnot(length(x_cols) > 0)

# -------- Filtros anti-colinealidad (en TRAIN) --------
# 1) varianza cero

x_cols <- x_cols[sd_vec > 0]

# 3) colinealidad perfecta |r|≈1
if (length(x_cols) > 1) {
  cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(cad[x_cols], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  bad_pairs <- which(abs(cmat) >= 0.99999 & upper.tri(cmat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(bad_pairs) > 0) {
    drop_perfect <- unique(colnames(cmat)[bad_pairs[,2]])
    x_cols <- setdiff(x_cols, drop_perfect)
  }
}
stopifnot(!(TARGET %in% x_cols), length(x_cols) > 0)
```

```{r}
# -------- Estandarización (medias/sd de Cadereyta) --------
scale_stats <- cad %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(x_cols),
                   list(mu = \(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), sd = \(x) sd(x, na.rm=TRUE))))

scale_apply <- function(data, stats_tbl, cols){
  out <- data
  for (v in cols) {

    sdv <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_sd")]]
    out[[v]] <- if (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0) 0 else (out[[v]] - mu)/sdv
  }
  out
}

cad_s <- scale_apply(cad, scale_stats, x_cols)
guad_s <- scale_apply(guad, scale_stats, x_cols)

```

```{r}
# -------- Estandarización (medias/sd de Cadereyta) --------
scale_stats <- cad %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(x_cols),
                   list(mu = \(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), sd = \(x) sd(x, na.rm=TRUE))))

scale_apply <- function(data, stats_tbl, cols){
  out <- data
  for (v in cols) {
    mu  <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_mu")]]
    sdv <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_sd")]]
    out[[v]] <- if (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0) 0 else (out[[v]] - mu)/sdv
  }
  out
}

cad_s <- scale_apply(cad, scale_stats, x_cols)
guad_s <- scale_apply(guad, scale_stats, x_cols)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 5️⃣ PREDICCIÓN Y MÉTRICAS
# =========================
pred_train <- predict(modelo_PM25, newdata = cad_s)
pred_test  <- predict(modelo_PM25, newdata = guad_s)

metricas <- function(obs, pred){
  tibble(
    RMSE = rmse_vec(obs, pred),
    MAE  = mae_vec(obs, pred),
    R2   = rsq_vec(obs, pred)
  )
}

train_met <- metricas(cad_s[[TARGET]], pred_train) |> mutate(dataset = "Cadereyta (train)")
test_met  <- metricas(guad_s[[TARGET]], pred_test)  |> mutate(dataset = "Guadalupe (test)")

bind_rows(train_met, test_met)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 7️⃣ GRÁFICAS DE AJUSTE
# =========================
p_train <- tibble(obs = cad_s[[TARGET]], pred = pred_train) |>
  ggplot(aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "Entrenamiento: Cadereyta", x = "Observado", y = "Predicho")

p_test <- tibble(obs = guad_s[[TARGET]], pred = pred_test) |>
  ggplot(aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color="steelblue") +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "Prueba: Juárez", x = "Observado", y = "Predicho")

p_train + p_test
```
